AI DISCLOSURE — Aurelith Forge

This product contains AI-assisted digital graphics and AI-assisted production planning. The final files were curated, named, exported, checked and packaged as a structured digital product.

What the buyer receives:
- Organized PNG assets
- SVG open-format alternatives for icons
- JSON design tokens
- A local HTML/CSS preview page
- Documentation and marketplace copy

This is not a PSD, Figma, Unity, Unreal or Godot project. It should not be described as engine-ready unless the buyer builds their own engine implementation.

No third-party brands, logos, franchise characters or intentionally copied game styles are included.

Free launch note: this release is provided as Free / Pay What You Want, but the same disclosure and usage limitations still apply.
